home.about.body: Tucked inside Ground Floor, Udchalo House (Plot No. 10, Clover Park, Viman Nagar), Caffè & Tè is an all-day sanctuary for coffee lovers, creatives, and comfort-food seekers. Sip our signature Vietnamese Iced Coffee or Hazelnut Butter Cappuccino under the open-air garden canopy, pick up a brush for a relaxing tabletop painting session, or step into our newly air-conditioned Pasta Social dining room for handmade pastas, flaky croissants, peri-peri fries, and cheesecake.

about.story.heading: Where Specialty Coffee Meets Art & Pasta Social
about.story.body_1: Caffè & Tè (कैफे & ते - ऑल डे कैफे) started with a simple love for slow-pulled espresso, artisanal loose-leaf teas, and an open-air garden setting in Clover Park where guests can linger for hours with a canvas and paintbrush.
about.story.body_2: With the launch of Pasta Social by Caffè & Tè — complete with warm lighting and newly installed air-conditioned indoor comfort — we bring handcrafted pastas, buttery croissants, peri-peri fries, and indulgent cheesecakes together under one roof for ₹200–400 per person.
about.chef.name: Small-Batch Beans & Handmade Comfort
about.chef.bio: From our condensed-milk Vietnamese Iced Coffee and Hazelnut Butter Cappuccino to vanilla cold brews, flaky croissants, and creamy Pasta Social bowls, every cup and plate is prepared fresh to order with warm, personal hospitality.
